name: CPU-based SDF Voxelization and Material Assignment
definition: A technique to populate 3D textures with Signed Distance Field (SDF) data and material properties by sampling an SDF surface on the CPU, handling time constraints via a loop, and committing the data to the GPU.
summary: CPU-based SDF Voxelization and Material Assignment populates 3D textures by sampling SDF surfaces on the host CPU within a frame time budget, allowing partial updates and distinct from GPU-based methods.
